item.description:

Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-04 Geofisica

The research activity will focus on assessing the feasibility and accuracy of applied geophysical methods for ground and subsurface characterization. The project will involve field and laboratory experimental activities aimed at acquiring geophysical data through the use of suitable techniques and instruments for the reconstruction of the physical and geomechanical properties of soils. The work will include the planning of measurement campaigns, the execution of experimental surveys, quality control of the collected data, and the subsequent processing and interpretation of the results. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Integrated Water Resources and Drought Management under Climate Change (CNR GEO - Istituto di Geoscienze)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-05 18:00
Institution: CNR GEO - Istituto di Geoscienze, Perugia
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-03 Geografia fisica, geomorfologia e geologia applicata

The project focuses on integrated water resources and drought management under climate change conditions. Research activities address the onset, evolution and propagation of meteorological droughts into agricultural and hydrological droughts, assessing the role of hydrological processes and human pressures. The project includes the development and application of methods and tools for drought monitoring, forecasting, risk assessment and management, through the integration of in situ observations, satellite data, climate reanalyses, hydrological modelling and artificial intelligence techniques. The final goal is to support sustainable water resources management and informed decision-making…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Postdoctoral assignment - Stronger Together: The Role of Connectivity in Safeguarding Functioning Coastal Ecosystems under Global Change (Univ. VENEZIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2027-01-15 13:00
Institution: Univ. VENEZIA, Venice
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-03 Geografia fisica, geomorfologia e geologia applicata

Bathymetric and coastal habitat mapping in selected study areas in Fiji, the Seychelles, and Belize, integrating remote sensing techniques (e.g., Satellite-Derived Bathymetry) with direct field-based surveys. Investigation of wave attenuation by mangroves, coral reefs, and seagrass meadows through a combination of hydrodynamic modelling and field observations. Development and implementation of numerical hydrodynamic models using XBeach, forced with measured boundary conditions and future climate scenarios.
